purpose: SON -> candidats lexicaux -> type de représentation -> potentiel visuel -> risque de dénomination -> rendement utile -> statut de preuve

methodology.denominator: The main reservoir is every useful sound classified C_exactWordVisualNotReady. Curated prototypes are added separately as calibration anchors even though the audit deliberately removes them from category C once they have a visual hypothesis.
methodology.visualPrediction: Only explicit curation contributes visualPotential or namingRisk. Unreviewed lexical candidates remain unknown; noun/frequency metadata are cues, not visual truth.
methodology.conventions: Letters, numbers and notes are represented as explicit visible conventions and remain distinct from pictograms.
methodology.approximations: Approximation evidence source: representation_bank_audit_compact. Approximate routes never become strict or clinically eligible from this map.
methodology.longWindows: One- and two-syllable windows compete. A two-syllable exact concept is retained as a first-class route and is not downgraded merely because it covers more sound.
methodology.calibration: Curated prototypes are not counted as solved coverage. They are anchors for comparing editorial visual predictions with later human naming observations.
methodology.activation: Nothing in this landscape activates an image or grants clinical status.
